Azeroth Survivors Flamestrike Mage build for Endless

Last updated: November 11, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Mengmeng’s Endless Mage stacks area damage around Flamestrike. The shared tree is 7 Arcane, 31 Fire and 13 Frost. It uses a Gnome, eight +5 Field Marshal PvP pieces and a legendary weapon. Start from those gear assumptions when comparing the setup with your own Mage.

Plan the opening and the transition

  1. Draft Flamestrike, Blizzard and Pyroblast early when the options allow. The author uses early critical chance to support Pyroblast while Flamestrike builds up.
  2. If packs move through your damage before it can finish them, improve Flamestrike’s uptime and coverage before spreading ranks across more damage spells.
  3. As Flamestrike covers your usual movement path, compare Blizzard area and uptime with more Flamestrike investment. Use the visible gaps around your route to choose the next upgrade.

Choose the survival trade-off before the run

The complete plan also includes Frost Nova, Fireball and Ice Barrier. Mengmeng banishes Barrier upgrades in this damage-focused setup. If you are still losing runs to ordinary waves, keep room in the upgrade pool for a survival option and treat the attempt as a variation on the published plan.

Use an in-run check

When you change jewelry, check how long the dangerous pack stays in the active damage area. For a useful comparison, record the difficulty, survival time and the reason the run ended. The author’s planner shows targets for a developed character; use the original plan to inspect the full loadout.
